entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leo Richard Smith was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of Ogdensburg in New York State for five months in 1963. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Buffalo in New York State from 1952 to 1963.
